mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% annualized coincides with higher corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 > 3% for 6 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals tight labor markets, which raises wage pressures and input costs, reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5% for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0% signals weakening manufacturing activity, lowering earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 0% for 6 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% combined with a 6-month rise in average hourly earnings (PAYEMS) above 2% signals tight labor markets with rising wage costs, reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
regime_hint: tight labor market with rising wage costs
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5% AND PAYEMS > 2% for 6 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% annualized combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200K units signals shifting consumption patterns away from durable goods, lowering corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 3% AND HOUST < 1200 for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero (t-test p > 0.05).
